transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: City bus No. 337 (Airport — Tbilisi centre) leaves from the stop in front of the arrivals hall, from 06:59 to 22:59. Through the centre it runs along Rustaveli Avenue and Freedom Square to Station Square. Fare 1 GEL including transfers within 90 minutes when paying with a Metro Money card or a bank card; the Metro Money card itself costs 2 GEL.

taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.text: Taxis are available round the clock at the exit from the arrivals hall. To the centre a fixed 40 GEL, to the suburbs 50 GEL, journey time 20–30 minutes depending on traffic.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi‑Fi without registration in most waiting areas of the departure and arrival terminals: networks Tbilisi Loves You or Airport Free Wi‑Fi, then accept the terms on the login page.
